name: The Grand Scepter
rulesText:
This relic **cannot** be removed from play or added to a lineage.

If you are Imperial and victorious against a Citizen, you may [favor-burnt] [favor-burnt] to exile them.

**ACTION:** You may become a Citizen if an Exile. **IN NEGOTIATION:** May offer Citizenship.

name: Sticky Fire
rulesText: If you're victorious, you may kill all the warbands in your enemy's force. If you do, you **must** give them [favor] if able.

name: Cursed Cauldron
rulesText: If you're victorious, gain 1 warband per enemy warband killed in this campaign.

name: Brass Horse
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Reveal the top card of your region's discard pile. Place your pawn at a different site with a matching card. If you **cannot**, place it at any site.

name: Truthful Harp
rulesText: You may draw 2 more cards. If you do, you **must** reveal every card you draw and the card you keep.

name: Grand Mask
rulesText: If you're an Exile, during your turn you rule cards except battle plans at Imperial sites, and Imperial players do not.

name: Horned Mask
rulesText: **WAKE:** You may take a non-edifice denizen from your site as a facedown adviser _(once per turn, like all Wake powers)_.

name: Cup of Plenty
rulesText: Spend no Supply if you're trading with a card that does not match any of your advisers.

name: Whistle
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Take a pawn from another site, place it at your site, and give them the [secret] here.

name: Dowsing Sticks
rulesText: [secret] [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Draw a relic from the relic deck and take it. _(You may keep it facedown.)_

name: Cracked Horn
rulesText: You may put all of the cards you discard on the bottom of the world deck.

name: Bandit Crown
rulesText: You may use cards at sites ruled by bandits as if you ruled them. _You may use these battle plans against bandits._

name: Ring of Devotion
rulesText: You may discard cards to your region's discard pile instead of the next region out.

name: Skeleton Key
rulesText: [secret] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** If your pawn is at a Hinterland site, take a relic from your site.

name: Oracular Pig
rulesText: **ACTION:** Peek at the top 3 cards of the world deck.

name: Circlet of Command
rulesText: Players **cannot** target your banners or your other relics.

name: Ivory Eye
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Peek at any facedown adviser. _(This includes Visions.)_

name: Shifting Map
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Gain 1 Supply.

name: Obsidian Cage
rulesText:
If you're victorious, move all unkilled warbands in your enemy's force to Obsidian Cage.

**ACTION:** Move any number of warbands from Obsidian Cage to any board of the same color.

name: Book of Records
rulesText: [secret] [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Take [favor] [favor] or [secret] [secret] from a banner held by a player whose pawn is at your site.

name: Dragonskin Drum
rulesText: After traveling, gain one warband.

name: Crystal Vial
rulesText: [secret] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Bury an adviser of yours or a denizen at your site. _(Bury ignores the locked restriction.)_

name: Ancient Writ
rulesText: **ACTION:** Bury this to draw 3 legacy cards, keep 1 facedown, and discard the other 2.

name: Painted Trumpet
rulesText: Instead of drawing from one discard pile, you may draw the top card from each discard pile. This draw amount **cannot** be modified.

name: Bone Dice
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Roll [attack-die] [attack-die]. Gain 1 Supply for each [sword] rolled, then bury this relic if you rolled any [skull].

name: Brass Army
rulesText:
[secret] +4 [attack-die]

Whenever your pawn moves _(travel or place)_, bury this or flip a secret you have facedown.

name: Imperial Seal
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** If no Imperial pawns are at your site, move any number of Imperial warbands from your site to any Imperial site or Imperial player board.

name: Fearsome Shield
rulesText: [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] +2 [defense-die]

name: Singing Mask
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Choose a denizen at your site. Move up to [favor] [favor] between the matching favor bank and the People's Favor.

name: Lost Tapestry
rulesText: Facedown Visions do not count against your adviser limit.

name: Bandit Standard
rulesText: + [attack-die] for each bandit in your region. This **cannot** be used while targeting sites ruled by bandits.

name: Silver Charm
rulesText: Each time you spend Supply to roll [attack-die], you may also reroll any number of previous [attack-die] at the same time.

name: Amber Flame
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Burn [favor-burnt] or [secret-burnt] from a banner held by a player whose pawn is at your site.

name: Wine of Welcome
rulesText: Draw from the bottom of the world deck instead of the top.

name: Whispering Stone
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Negotiate with any one player in private, even if their pawn is not at your site.

name: Black Sword
rulesText: [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] +5 [attack-die]

name: Barbed Net
rulesText: [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Take a relic from your site. _(You may keep it facedown.)_

name: Bag of Siegeworks
rulesText: [secret] If you're targeting sites, ignore [defense-die] rolls with a single [shield].

name: Secret Testament
rulesText: When an enemy takes a banner from you, take all [favor] or [secret] on the banner.

name: Magic Carpet
rulesText: **ACTION:** Place your pawn at any site. Then, discard Magic Carpet or give it to a player at a different site.

name: Yew Staff
rulesText: When using card powers, you may act as if you hold the Darkest Secret.

name: Spiteful Mirror
rulesText: [secret] This turn, you may act as if any cards you use to trade or muster are [suit-discord] cards.

name: Weeping Banner
rulesText: [secret] The attacker **must** resolve another [skull] for each [skull] rolled.

name: Sigil of the Eye
rulesText: You may challenge the Darkest Secret from any site.

name: Sigil of the Heart
rulesText: You may challenge the People's Favor from any site.

name: Magic Waterskin
rulesText: **ACTION:** Bury this relic to gain 4 Supply.

name: Demon Tail
rulesText: [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Gain 2 Supply.

name: Clay Rattle
rulesText: [secret] [secret] **ACTION:** Shuffle the world deck or any region's discard pile.
